story.title: Our Story
story.imageAlt: JC and Jecel facing each other in a field of pampas grass
paragraphs: It all started with a simple introduction, a shared laugh, and a spark that neither of us saw coming. Whether it was fate, good timing, or a little bit of both, our paths crossed and our lives changed forever. What began as casual conversations quickly turned into late-night talks, shared adventures, and the realization that we had found something incredibly special.

From that very first date, we knew this wasn't just a fleeting romance. Together, we've built a life filled with unforgettable memories—navigating the highs and lows, celebrating milestones, and growing closer with each passing day. We became each other's biggest cheerleaders, favorite travel partners, and truest best friends. Through all the laughter, the quiet moments, and the daily adventures, we realized we didn't want to imagine a future without the other in it.

photoBand.imageAlt: JC and Jecel among the rose bushes

proposal.title: The Proposal
paragraphs: On May 3, 2026, our journey reached new heights—literally. High above the ground on the giant ferris wheel at Sky Ranch, with the stunning views stretching out around us and the wind in the air, JC asked the easiest question Jecel would ever have to answer. Up in our own quiet world above the lights and excitement below, it was a moment filled with tears, laughter, and an overwhelming amount of joy. Of course, the answer was a resounding, “Yes!”
proposal.imageAlt: A film strip of the couple dancing in a garden and walking by a pond, beside a polaroid of JC twirling Jecel under a blue sky

gifts.lead: Your presence is our greatest gift
gifts.text: With all that we have, we've been truly blessed. Your presence at our wedding is all that we request. However, if you wish to honor us with a gift, a monetary contribution toward building our future home and new life together would be warmly received.
gifts._ways: Optional ways to give, shown as small chips under the envelope, e.g. ["Cash gift on the day", "GCash: 09xx xxx xxxx"]. Leave empty to hide.
gifts._accounts: Cards with a QR code for sending a gift. These are SAMPLES: replace each qr image (images/gift-qr/), name and number with your real details, or delete the list to hide it. Set "sample": false once a card is real.
gifts.accountsNote: Scan with your banking or e-wallet app, or tap Copy to use the account number.

gallery.intro: A few of our favorite moments together. Tap any photo to see it up close.
gallery._howToAddPhotos: Put photos in the images/gallery folder and name them 1.jpg, 2.jpg, 3.jpg … (a skipped number is fine, e.g. after deleting a photo). They appear automatically in that order (.jpg, .jpeg, .png and .webp all work). Tip: resize photos to about 1600px on the long side so the page stays fast.
gallery._photosByName: Instead of "auto" you can list files by name, in the order you want: ["beach.jpg", { "file": "park.jpg", "caption": "Picnic day" }]
gallery._captions: Optional caption for each numbered photo, shown when hovering or viewing it full screen.
gallery._grid: The photo grid opens with the first "showFirst" photos; the button reveals the rest ({count} = total photos).
gallery._count: The number is the photo count, worked out automatically.
gallery._stats: Little counters under the number. type: "photos" (number of gallery photos), "since" (days since a date), "until" (days until a date), or "text" (any short value).

faq.intro: Here's everything you need to know about our big day, from parking and timelines to dress codes and RSVPs.
faq._formatting: In answers: **bold**, *italic*, [link text](https://... or #section), and \n for a line break.

items.question: When is the RSVP deadline?
answer: Please RSVP by **April 10, 2027** so we can get an accurate headcount.

items.question: What time do we need to arrive?
answer:
**Entourage, Sponsors & Immediate Family:**
Please be at the church by **12:00 PM**. This gives our coordinators enough time for corsage and boutonnière pin-ups, pre-ceremony pictorials, and a quick walkthrough of the processional line-up and aisle walk before guests take their seats.

**All Guests:**
Please arrive by **12:30 PM** so everyone can be comfortably settled before the ceremony begins at 1:00 PM.

items.question: Can I bring a plus one?
answer: Due to venue capacity, we can only accommodate guests named on the invitation.

items.question: What should I wear?
answer: Smart-casual Filipiniana looks for ladies and beige suits or knitted polos for gentlemen, in warm earth tones. See the [Attire Guide](#finer-details) for details.

items.question: What are your gift preferences?
answer: We are deeply appreciative of the time and effort you'll dedicate to joining us on our special day. Should you wish to offer a gift, monetary contributions toward our new journey together would be greatly valued as we begin building our future.
